title: Portable Windows External-SSD Staging Auto Pilot and Active Dev Tunnel Boundary

phases.objective: Provide a portable Windows/External-SSD launcher that starts only a pinned local Staging tree and exposes only the ready Dev hostname through an explicit opt-in Tunnel profile.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The launcher either validates and starts the exact local repository safely or stops before mutation with a fail-closed diagnostic.
steps: Require an exact 40-character commit SHA and verify the remote ref and detached checkout resolve to that SHA.
Reject a dirty tree, DOCKER_HOST, DOCKER_CONTEXT, non-local Docker contexts, unavailable Docker, or unreadable WSL2 state.
Verify manifest SHA-256 values for Compose, env template, domain policy, OpenAPI/MCP policy, generated Staging OpenAPI artifact, DB copy tool, regression tests, documentation, and Auto Pilot files.
Create only an ignored local .env.staging with local-only credentials when absent; never copy Production credentials or provider tokens.
Parse the merged Compose model and start local services without migrations, SQL apply, provider calls, or Production deployment.
Start cloudflared only when the operator explicitly supplies -StartTunnel and a non-empty dedicated Staging token.
assertions: The exact commit is pinned and read back before service startup.
MIGRATION_APPLIED=false and DATABASE_MUTATED=false are required and exact.
The staging SSO cookie mode is host_only and Production hostnames are rejected from the active tunnel list.
The active tunnel hostnames are exactly dev.mad4b.com and mcp_dev.mad4b.com and their origin is exactly http://app:8080.
activation_dev.mad4b.com remains reserved-disabled and is not active Tunnel ingress.
cloudflared is behind the explicit tunnel profile, uses a digest-pinned image, depends only on app, and has no database or provider access.
Auto Pilot performs no Cloudflare DNS mutation, Hostinger deployment, migration, database mutation, or credential payload read.

phases.objective: Validate the live Dev Tunnel from the operator's Windows host after authorized Cloudflare-side ingress configuration.
blockers: The Cloudflare dashboard/API configuration is provider-side and is intentionally not mutated by Auto Pilot.
Live validation requires the operator's Windows host, Docker Desktop/WSL2, the local app, and a dedicated Dev tunnel token.

phases.objective: Add independent tunnel health/readback evidence and operator-visible rollback guidance without sharing Production credentials.
No Cloudflare, Hostinger, DNS, or external-provider canary is executed by this source change.
Production remains on Hostinger Cloud and is not changed by this local Staging Auto Pilot.
blockers: Production deployment and Hostinger-side operations are explicitly out of scope for this Staging closure PR.
